facts.text: Star City is an Apple TV spinoff of For All Mankind, told from the Soviet side of the same alternate-history space race. It premiered May 29, 2026 with two episodes, then one new episode every Friday through the July 10 finale.
Ben Nedivi and Matt Wolpert created it and serve as showrunners, with For All Mankind creator Ronald D. Moore and Maril Davis of Tall Ship Productions among the executive producers.
Rhys Ifans plays the Soviet chief designer and Anna Maxwell Martin plays Lyudmilla Raskova, the head of KGB surveillance.
Variety called it an intense, immaculate alt-history paranoid thriller, in contrast to the more optimistic tone of its parent show.
